scope: Static contract, classic-script VM rendering, local resources and real default/state/art image decoding

checks.description: docs/design/game-ui/systems.json parses as JSON
The UI simulation reads its preserved, hash-locked v4 screenplay and validates every successor in the current reader
30 gameplay systems, 11 underlying systems, 72 screens, 12 groups and 13 flows
System, underlying system, screen, group and flow IDs are unique within each collection
Each screen belongs to exactly one declared gameplay system
All storyRefs identify real scenes in the explicitly frozen v4 UI screenplay; current reader successors are separately validated
UI screen references cover all 43 scenes of their frozen v4 screenplay
Every flow references existing screens
Underlying systems map to real pages and evidence documents and distinguish existing evidence from targets
Prototype index.html exists and contains an HTML entry point
HTML loads data, core, all three renderer modules and app in contract order
Every classic HTML script parses as JavaScript
Classic data.js and ui-core.js provide GAME_UI_DATA and the renderer registry
data.js matches current systems.json
data.js matches its explicit frozen v4 UI story source, image mappings and source hash
All renderer modules execute in the classic-script VM
Exactly 72 canonical screens are registered with no duplicate or extra registrations
Every registered page actually renders nonempty substantive HTML from an isolated state fixture
Rendered pages have distinct body HTML and visible-text hashes after ignoring shared heading/navigation
data-go and same-document hash links identify canonical pages or real internal definitions
All local HTML, rendered image/src and CSS url resources exist
Present preview files have JPEG SOI/EOI and positive image dimensions
All 72 canonical pages have valid previews/<id>.jpg files
data.js previewIds matches the available valid JPEG previews
data.js statePreviews exactly matches all catalog states, order and safe per-state filenames
Present declared state files have JPEG SOI/EOI and positive dimensions
Every declared catalog state has its own valid previews/states JPEG file
All six declared new 2D art assets exist inside the prototype folder
Every present default/state screenshot and new art file fully decodes, has positive dimensions, expected format and nonuniform pixels
Default screenshots and state screenshots are each unique in both file bytes and decoded RGB pixels
docs/design/game-ui/prototype/preview-manifest.json parses as JSON
Manifest lists every current primary image with matching file hash, decoded pixel hash and dimensions

imageDecode.method: Pillow Image.open().load(), decoded RGB pixel hash and extrema through RTK

notCovered: No browser, DOM layout, real user input, action handler or accessibility execution was performed.

Pillow fully decodes current image bytes; hashes, nonblank pixels and dimensions do not establish visual quality or screenshot/page identity. Browser facts and contact-sheet visual review are recorded separately in preview-manifest.json.
No Godot runtime, GPU, gameplay, performance or native persistence verification was performed.
